title: In the known-defect replay, an import of a failed part's package raises, so a fallback catcher reads UNKNOWN
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1, 15:22 CST (coordinator ask): under decision mutation-ci-report-and-replay, a catcher with an optional-import fallback reads CAUGHT when its part failed to install. Closes debt known-defects-fallback-caught, which lands with PR #1453.
note: During the replay, an import of a failed part's package raises, so such a catcher reads UNKNOWN, never CAUGHT. Unowned until the coordinator starts it.
